definitions.gloss: to observe; to watch closely; to examine carefully
definitions.explanation: To look at something attentively and systematically in order to learn about it. Used in scientific, educational, and everyday contexts for careful examination of people, nature, or phenomena.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{観察|かんさつ}する。
{子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{観察|かんさつ}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。

⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注意深|ちゅういぶか}く→注意深い：16848_chuuibukai⟧{観察|かんさつ}して、⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}して→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please observe the patient carefully and report any changes.

notes:
Implies systematic, purposeful watching — not casual looking. Commonly used in science education, nature study, and medical/clinical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{観察|かんさつ}する: to observe nature
- ⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{観察|かんさつ}する: to observe behavior
- ⟦{観察|かんさつ}{力|りょく}→観察力：08524_kansatsuryoku⟧: powers of observation
- ⟦{観察|かんさつ}→観察：02558_kansatsu⟧⟦{日記|にっき}→日記：01486_nikki⟧: observation diary (common school assignment)
